name.zh: 散文随笔与深度非虚构

summary.en: Protects concrete observation and voice against moralizing paragraph endings, second-order negation pivots, em-dash saturation, and half-width Chinese punctuation.
summary.zh: 克制段尾升华说教、二阶对比金句、破折号过密与中文半角标点混排，保留具体细节与自然语感。

patterns: (?:总而言之|综上所述|归根结底|说到底)[，,][^。！？\n]{2,40}

message.en: Moralizing summary formula flattens concrete scene observation at the end of a passage.
message.zh: 段尾出现说教升华套句，冲淡了前文的具体细节。

deletionTest.en: Cut the final moralizing sentence completely and stop on the concrete physical detail right before it.
deletionTest.zh: 直接删去最后一句升华总结，在它前面的具体动作或画面处收尾。

exemplar.bad: 傍晚六点半，修表匠把拆下的三枚铜齿轮泡进煤油皿里，关掉台灯。这或许就是慢工出细活在喧嚣时代真正的意义所在。
exemplar.trap: 傍晚六点半，三枚铜齿轮泡进煤油皿。这不是修表，而是与时间的对话。
exemplar.good: 傍晚六点半，修表匠把拆下的三枚铜齿轮泡进煤油皿里，关掉台灯。

note.en: Delete the closing moral; keep '傍晚六点半', '三枚铜齿轮', and '煤油皿' without adding invented details.
note.zh: 删去尾句升华，原样保留“六点半”“三枚铜齿轮”“煤油皿”，不添油加醋。

hit: 雨停之后巷口只剩积水，这正是平凡生活的意义所在。
这或许就是慢工出细活在喧嚣时代真正的意义所在。
唯有守住内心的平静，我们才能在快节奏里找到方向。
clean: 雨停之后，巷口杂货铺老板拿竹帚把台阶上的积水扫进明沟。
他在旧账本最后一页记下三笔欠款，合上封皮。

message.en: Formulaic wistful conclusion tells the reader what to feel instead of ending on the scene.
message.zh: 英文感伤升华结语直接替读者总结情绪，削弱了叙事余味。

deletionTest.en: Delete the concluding reflection; let the preceding image or quote carry the ending.
deletionTest.zh: 删掉结尾抒情总结句，让前一句的具体意象或对话自然收束。

exemplar.bad: At 6:15 a.m., the ferry deck smelled of wet rope and diesel. Ultimately, this reminds us that departures are always quieter than arrivals.
exemplar.trap: Wet rope. Cold diesel. Quiet departures at 6:15 a.m.
exemplar.good: At 6:15 a.m., the ferry deck smelled of wet rope and diesel.

note.en: Cut the aphorism and keep '6:15 a.m.', 'wet rope', and 'diesel'.
note.zh: 删掉格言式尾巴，保留清晨 6:15 与绳索柴油气味。

hit: Ultimately, this reminds us that memory is fragile.
And maybe, just maybe, that was enough for both of them.
clean: She folded the receipt into her coat pocket and stepped onto the tram.
By November, the courtyard persimmon tree had dropped all but four fruits.

message.en: Formulaic 'Not X, but Y' / '不是 A，而是 B' aphorism interrupts narrative texture.
message.zh: 套路化“不是 A，而是 B”金句打断叙事质感。

deletionTest.en: Replace the abstract contrast with what the person actually did, said, or noticed.
deletionTest.zh: 删掉抽象对比金句，改写人物实际做出的动作或看到的细节。

exemplar.bad: 老周留下的那把旧刨子不是工具，而是手艺人的尊严。
exemplar.trap: 一把旧刨子。半生木工活。满手老茧。
exemplar.good: 老周退休那天把用了二十年的旧刨子擦净木屑，收进樟木箱底。

note.en: Show how the plane was cared for instead of declaring it a symbol.
note.zh: 写出擦拭收纳旧刨子的动作，不贴“尊严”标签。

hit: 那盏台灯不是照明器具，而是深夜里的陪伴。
It wasn't just rain — it was a reckoning.
His grandfather's hand plane wasn't just a tool — it was a quiet testament to patience.
clean: 那班绿皮车停靠的不是三号站台，而是最北边的五号货运站台。
He ordered tea, not coffee, and waited by the window.

message.en: High em-dash (`—` / `——`) frequency creates breathless LLM parenthetical rhythm.
message.zh: 破折号（`—` / `——`）密度过高，形成典型生成式插话腔。

deletionTest.en: Convert most parenthetical dashes into commas or periods; save a single dash for a genuine turn.
deletionTest.zh: 将多数插话破折号改为逗号或句号，只在真正语意陡转处保留一处破折号。

exemplar.bad: The station clock — brass-rimmed — stopped at 4:10 — right before the snow — while three passengers — coats buttoned — waited outside.
exemplar.trap: Brass clock. 4:10 sharp. Snow falling. Three passengers waiting.
exemplar.good: The brass-rimmed station clock stopped at 4:10, right before the snow, while three passengers waited outside in buttoned coats.

note.en: Chinese double half-em `——` counts as one dash; only sustained saturation (> 4 per 300 words) triggers.
note.zh: 中文规范破折号 `——` 按单次计数，仅在单段高密度堆叠时提示。

hit: One — two — three — four — five — six dashes in twelve words.
clean: 他推开木门——屋里炉火还没灭，壶水正冒着白气。
The train arrived eight minutes late — unusual for Tuesday mornings.

message.en: Half-width ASCII punctuation (`,;:!?`) wedged directly between Chinese characters.
message.zh: 汉字之间混入半角西文标点（`,;:!?`），违反中文排版规范（W3C CLREQ）。

deletionTest.en: Replace half-width ASCII punctuation between Han characters with full-width Chinese punctuation (`，；：！？`).
deletionTest.zh: 将汉字之间的半角标点替换为全角中文标点（`，；：！？`）。

exemplar.bad: 冬至那天下了初雪,院子里的腊梅开了三朵;香气一直飘到走廊。
exemplar.trap: 冬至初雪。腊梅三朵。暗香盈袖。
exemplar.good: 冬至那天下了初雪，院子里的腊梅开了三朵；香气一直飘到走廊。

note.en: Normalize punctuation width without altering wording or numbers.
note.zh: 仅修正标点全半角，不改动原文措辞与数量。

hit: 今天天气晴朗,适合出门散步!
第一阶段已完成;第二阶段周四启动。
clean: 今天天气晴朗，适合出门散步！
请求头包含 `Accept: application/json, text/plain` 字段。
